company_phase.label: Company phase
company_phase.statement: 2026 is the foundation/preparation period. 2027 is the beginning of the launch phase and operational integration into the Brittany ecosystem. Exact launch month, production volume, revenue target and final pricing remain unfixed.
company_phase.next_gate: Preserve evidence-gated preparation through 2026 and create separate controlled decisions for launch details when evidence is sufficient.

workstreams.label: MAT
workstreams.statement: MAT remains a Phase 0 evidence problem before production freeze. Current controlled context does not authorize treating PCB, Gerbers, thresholds, fusion or the final stack as frozen until feasibility is demonstrated.
workstreams.next_gate: Demonstrate physical feasibility and incremental value over TAG-only before locking the two-device commercial architecture.

workstreams.label: TAG
workstreams.statement: The repository contains partial TAG firmware and engineering work. Repository presence is not physical or production validation.
workstreams.next_gate: Attach controlled physical bring-up, trust, RF/power/mechanical and end-to-end evidence before production claims.

workstreams.label: Core software
workstreams.statement: Web, mobile, Hono API, PostgreSQL/Drizzle paths and shared packages exist on main. Authentication register/login/refresh remains gated, data paths are not yet fully unified, and disposable database QA is not production migration authority.
workstreams.next_gate: Close the narrow production-critical identity, durable backend-contract and release-authority gaps without expanding unrelated scope.

workstreams.label: ELI
workstreams.statement: ELI is governed as bounded interpretation under uncertainty with provenance, quality and abstention. Code or prototypes do not establish scientific validation, and unsupported discrete emotional or diagnostic claims remain forbidden.
workstreams.next_gate: Advance only through controlled scientific/product gates with explicit provenance and abstention behavior.

workstreams.label: World / Unity
workstreams.statement: A validated loopback live Unity → Hono → Nakama spike now exists on main, covering two-user bootstrap, presence, preset chat, renewal, and degraded transport. This is spike evidence only and does not authorize production World release, durable client authority, deployment readiness, or product-value conclusions.
workstreams.next_gate: Keep World outside production authority until explicit product-value, retention, security/deployment, and production-readiness gates justify promotion.

workstreams.label: Funding
workstreams.statement: Funding should buy proof and de-risking. Eligibility, awards and investor commitment must never be inferred from discussions. Major irreversible spend should follow evidence and financing sequence.
workstreams.next_gate: Build the finance/fundraising state from sourced costs, milestones, runway assumptions and verified funding evidence.

workstreams.label: Corporate / IP
workstreams.statement: A public-safe Corporate/IP index now exists. Final entity/governance structure, chain-of-title, third-party rights, and public-repository licensing/contribution policy remain controlled open gates; this projection is not legal sign-off.
workstreams.next_gate: Advance the source gates in #114, #116 and #680 with controlled evidence and reviewed dispositions while keeping restricted instruments and personal data outside the public repository.

critical_gates.question: Does MAT create sufficient incremental value over TAG-only to justify a two-device commercial architecture?
Do controlled physical tests support the intended MAT/TAG evidence paths with repeatability and trustworthy provenance?
Does a narrow end-to-end product create recurring owner value before broader Community/World/platform expansion?
Are hardware COGS, support cost, pricing logic and financing need evidenced well enough to support a launch decision?
Are contribution ownership, third-party rights and public-repository policy controlled before scale?

confidentiality.rule: Store public-safe state, status, hashes and references only. Keep secrets, PII, signatures, bank data, confidential supplier material, executed legal originals and restricted investor terms outside the public repository.
